readiness_statement: V5.2 is a field-pilot-ready prototype. It is not field-validated or production-ready.

evidence: The explicitly synthetic same-context rehearsal covers import, promotion, four strategy plans, provider decline/replan, changes requested, approval, execution log, post-metrics, and calibration re-evaluation.
A separate persisted PILOT API integration test sends official-directory identity plus confirmed local operations and price through the optimizer.
Pilot plan inputs are scoped to a pilot_context_id.
PILOT optimizer integration asserts DEMO provider inputs = 0 and DEMO provenance rows = 0.
Missing pilot inputs fail closed; scenario assumptions are separately labeled SIMULATION.
Persisted REAL_DIRECTORY organization identity is joined to confirmed LOCAL_AUTHORITY_INPUT availability/capacity and PROVIDER_SELF_REPORTED price at the PILOT optimizer API.
Provider and source provenance are retained in the plan snapshot.
field_validation_pending: Current provider participation, capacity, and prices are not verified; the official-directory fixture is dated 2025-12-31.

evidence: Preview, row validation, explicit confirmation, context promotion, row-level partial import, transaction rollback on injected row-80 promotion failure, and idempotent replay are tested.
A row-level validation error yields IMPORTED_WITH_ERRORS for valid rows; a storage/promotion failure rolls back the entire 100-row batch.
Execution logs link to approved plan version, round, provider, area, and service; duplicate confirmation creates no duplicate log.
Metrics preserve UNKNOWN when a partial execution sample cannot establish plan-wide rates or variances.
Synthetic execution logs cannot promote calibration to LOCAL_VALIDATED_OPERATIONAL.

provenance.evidence: Plan snapshots and audit events retain planning context, import batches, source records, demand/evidence, price/cost inputs, route snapshot fingerprint, optimizer version, approval/version, and execution linkage.

data_go_kr.evidence: Successful snapshot followed by live failure is tested through the data.go.kr adapter and API provenance response; evidence UI explicitly says cached snapshot used.

external_api_resilience.tests: 40 passed, 1 skipped across tests/test_external_ingestion.py, tests/test_travel.py, and tests/test_route_failure.py; the skip is opt-in live smoke.

automated_baseline: Keyboard-visible focus, semantic landmarks, heading hierarchy, labels, table captions/scoped headers, map alternative, and 390/1024/1280/1440px pilot layouts.
Focus assertions cover import row-error summary and successful result, demand review/approval, scenario result, pilot plan creation/replan, and approval status.
No audited pilot action uses a modal dialog, so modal-close focus restoration is NOT_APPLICABLE.

evidence: Resident contact is redacted from preview/error output and minimized from plan feedback snapshots/default outputs.
Resident contacts are absent from captured application logs; provider API keys are absent from captured logs/errors and redacted from persisted source provenance.
Raw free text is not copied into the plan snapshot when only minimized feedback metadata is needed.
privacy.scope_limit: This is a tested prototype privacy baseline, not a security certification or production access-control design.

solver_regression.interpretation: No regression detected in the paired comparison. TIME_LIMIT and UNKNOWN are limitations only when present in both baseline and current results; they do not establish optimality or field performance.

manual_validation_pending: Real screen-reader user testing and observed accessibility use.
Live authority-user review and approval practice.
Prototype host access-control review before any shared pilot use.
field_validation_pending: Actual institution dataset and authority-confirmed legal-area mappings.
Actual longitudinal resident demand and validated demand accuracy.
Current real provider availability, capacity, prices, and participation.
Actual service executions and sufficient plan-wide outcome records.
Live authority users and real field accessibility observations.
remaining_limits: Field validation is NOT_STARTED; synthetic fixtures are not field results.
The official directory fixture is dated 2025-12-31; current provider status is unknown.
Authentication and production authorization are absent; only a trusted access-controlled prototype setting is in scope.
Live external API smoke was not run; offline adapter failure behavior passed.
TIME_LIMIT and UNKNOWN solver outcomes remain at the same paired V5.1 cases.
Partial execution logs leave completion rate, zero-service totals, cost variance, schedule variance, and unmet services UNKNOWN.
